（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. /xxx/, Date Jan. 6, 1939.）

Subject Seizure of copies of book entitled "Duty of Young Men"

Made √ and Forwarded by D. S. McKeown.

On the morning of January 5 Special Branch detectives
visited five bookstores and seized 64 copies of a book
entitled "Duty of Young Men" (青年的任務) published by the
Managing Office of the "News Digest" (譯報管理處) at
117 Avenue Edward VII. Details of the visits are given
below:-

| Name and Address of Bookstore | Visited By | Seizure |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1) Kwong Min Bookstore (光明書店), 296 Foochow Road. | D.S. Pitts and C.D.C. 360 Sung Shao-oen. | 1 Copy |
| 2) Far Eastern Magazine Company (遠東雜誌公司), 378 Foochow Road. | D.S. Hide and C.D.S. 24 Hsu Jih-sin. | 33 Copies |
| 3) China Book Company (中國雜誌公司), 380 Foochow Road. | D.S. Mocking and C.D.C. 280 Li Hai-feng. | 2 " |
| 4) Hsin Tsing Nien Bookstore (新青年書店), 231 Yu Yuen Road. | D.S. McKeown and C.D.C. 230 Chang Yeh. | 27 " |
| 5) Wen Tuh Bookstore (文徒書店), 680 Avenue Road. | D.S.I. Logan and C.D.C. 358 Li Kwang-zai. | 1 " |

EXTRACTS FROM A BOOK ENTITLED THE "DUTY OF YOUNG MEN" (青年的任務)
PUBLISHER: Library Department of News Digest
SALES OFFICE: Managing Office of News Digest, No. 117 Avenue
Adward VII.

Page 14
Shanghai is an occupied district surrounded by
the enemy. Our students have not suffered painful oppression
as have students in the other occupied areas because of the
existence of the foreign Settlements. Thus we can still sing
our national anthem and read the original classics. Many
students of middle schools or primary schools have been driven
like a flock of sheep to the place appointed by the enemy and
traitors to salute the "five-barred flag", to sing the so-called
"national song", to hear the enemy and the traitors speak on
Sino-Japanese friendship,.... Is it not sad to see those
youths and students as if they were being driven to the
guillotine? Must we shout for resistance only when we
ourselves are being made to suffer?
For singing a national anthem, a school master
has been arrested, schoolboys under ten beaten, many were
killed and some were buried alive. All this happened in
Soochow after August 13 last year. Should not these facts
awaken us? Then, why have the students and youths of Shanghai
failed to organize? In the interests of our country and for
your own sake, organize at once! You should do your best to
display your democratic spirit --- to struggle without fear of
outside forces!
Page 15

along Nanking Road, human heads and hands began to appear
here and there, and hand-grenades were thrown at various

摘自题为《青年的任务》一书
出版者：译报图书馆部
销售处：译报管理处，爱多亚路117号。

第14页
上海是被敌人包围的占领区。由于外国租界的存
在，我们的学生没有像其他占领区的学生那样遭受痛苦的压
迫。因此，我们仍然可以唱国歌，读原著经典。许多中学或
小学的学生被像羊群一样驱赶到敌人和汉奸指定的地点，向
“五色旗”敬礼，唱所谓的“国歌”，听敌人和汉奸讲演中日
亲善，……看到那些青年和学生仿佛被驱赶至断头台，难道
不令人悲伤吗？难道只有当我们自己遭受苦难时，才应该高
呼抵抗吗？
因为唱国歌，一位校长被捕，十岁以下的学童遭
殴打，许多人被杀，有些人被活埋。这一切都发生在去年八
月十三日后的苏州。这些事实难道不应唤醒我们吗？那么，
为什么上海的学生和青年未能组织起来？为了我们国家的利
益，也为了你们自己，立即组织起来！你们应尽力展现民主
精神——不畏外力地进行斗争！
第15页
去年12月3日，在南京路举行大规模游行后，到
处开始出现人头和人手，手榴弹被投向各个

pages.en:
(2)

newspaper officers while the Settlement authorities were
threatened also. This widespread terror was intended to
crush the national salvation movement and the patriotism
of our countrymen. Our work is to organize ourselves
and strengthen our units. We adopted many ceremonial
forms to arouse the patriotism of 4,000,000 people of
Shanghai, and made the Settlement authorities know the
might of the Chinese. Thus, with the co-operation of
the Settlement authorities, we have strengthened our
people's resistance to the devil. With the help of our
comrades in cultural and newspaper circles and the support
of patriotic movements by the 4,000,000 inhabitants of
Shanghai, we have organized a thrift movement and an offer
gold movement, shifted our industries inland and repatriated
youths to the interior.

We have not yet fulfilled our national duty.
Women are still the chief consumers of enemy goods today;
this is the first responsibility of the people of Shanghai,
especially ladies! There are still many Chinese employees
of foreign firms haunting dance halls and amusement resorts;
this is the responsibility of the students and youths of
Shanghai! And there are also many countrymen, who, driven
by their need for a livelihood, have shamelessly joined the
enemy and thus become traitors and spies; this is the
responsibility of the cultural youths and workers of
Shanghai! Fu Siao-en has been put on the stage: this is
the responsibility of the youths of industrial and
commercial circles.

Students and young men should organize cultural
groups and work for the defence of their country. They
should go to guerrilla areas to assist in political propaganda.
pages.zh:
(2)

报社职员，同时租界当局也受到威胁。这种广泛的恐怖旨在
粉碎救国运动和我们同胞的爱国心。我们的工作是将我们自
己组织起来，加强我们的队伍。我们采用许多仪式形式来唤
起上海四百万民众的爱国心，并使租界当局知晓中国人的力
量。因此，在租界当局的配合下，我们加强了人民对魔鬼的
抵抗。在文化界和新闻界同仁的帮助以及上海四百万居民对
爱国运动的支持下，我们组织了节约运动和献金运动，将工
业内迁，并将青年遣返内地。

我们尚未履行我们的国家责任。
如今，妇女仍是敌货的主要消费者；这是上海人民，
尤其是女士们的首要责任！仍有许多在外商公司任职的中国
雇员流连于舞厅和娱乐场所；这是上海学生和青年的责任！
还有许多同胞，因生计所迫，无耻地投靠敌人，从而成为汉
奸和间谍；这是上海文化青年和工人的责任！傅筱庵已被搬
上舞台：这是工商界青年的责任。

学生和青年应组织文化团体，为保卫国家而工作。
他们应前往游击区协助进行政治宣传。
